'''Hernando Burgos Soto''' is a Canadian (Colombian born) educator and mathematician, professor of mathematics at [[George Brown College]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.georgebrown.ca/bio/hernando-burgos-soto | title=Hernando Burgos-Soto, PhD | publisher=George Brown College | accessdate=6 April 2025}}</ref> He is the author of several math papers in which he introduced some mathematics concepts and extended to [[tangle theory|tangles]] some celebrated results of [[knot theory]] about the Khovanov homology and the Jones polynomial.<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Burgos-Soto|first1=Hernando|title=The Jones Polynomial and the Planar algebra of alternating tangles|journal=Journal of Knot Theory and Its Ramifications|date=2010|volume=19|issue=11|page=1487|doi=10.1142/S0218216510008510|arxiv=0807.2600|s2cid=13993750 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|last1=Bar-Natan|first1=Dror|last2=Burgos-Soto|first2=Hernando|title=The Khovanov homology for alternating tangles|journal=Journal of Knot Theory and Its Ramifications|date=Feb 2014|volume=23|issue=2|page=1450013|doi=10.1142/S0218216514500138|arxiv=1003.4766|s2cid=119237571 }}</ref> During his career as a mathematician, his interests have included [[Mathematical Statistics]], [[Knot Theory]], [[Algebraic Topology]] and more recently [[Mathematical Finance]].
He is comfortable writing in English and Spanish. When writing in Spanish, he works in the area of [[prose fiction]] writing short stories. Some of his short stories were published at the website Cuentos y Cuentos.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Minas|first1=Adrian|title=Hernando Burgos-Soto|url=http://www.cuentosycuentos.com/hernando-burgos.html|website=Cuentos y Cuentos|publisher=Cuentos Y Cuentos|accessdate=18 November 2015}}</ref>

==Education==
Professor Burgos Soto holds a BSc.Ed in mathematics at the [[University of Atlántico]] and a MSc in Mathematics from the [[University of Valle]]. He earned a PhD in mathematics from [[National University of Colombia]] in 2009, and completed his dissertation at [[University of Toronto]] under the guidance of professor [[Dror Bar-Natan]].<ref>{{cite web|last1=Burgos-Soto|first1=Hernando|title=Mathematics Genealogy Project|url=http://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=138790|website=Mathematics Genealogy Project|accessdate=18 November 2015}}</ref>

==Research==
His works include [[regression diagnostic]] analysis for [[General Linear Model]]s,<ref>{{cite web|last1=Digital|first1=Biblioteca|title=Diagnostic Analysis in Generalized Linear Models|url=http://bibliotecadigital.univalle.edu.co/bitstream/10893/1670/3/13%20Resumenes%20de%20articulos,%20proyectos%20y%20tesis.pdf|website=REsument de Proyectos y tesis|publisher=Universidad Del Valle|accessdate=18 November 2015}}</ref> extension to tangles of [[Morwen Thistlethwaite]]'s result on the alternation of the [[Jones polynomial]] for alternating links,<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Burgos-Soto|first1=Hernando|title=The Jones Polynomial and the Planar algebra of alternating tangles|journal=Journal of Knot Theory and Its Ramifications|date=2010|volume=19|issue=11|page=1487|doi=10.1142/S0218216510008510|arxiv=0807.2600|s2cid=13993750 }}</ref> and a Lee's result on [[Khovanov homology]] for [[link (knot theory)|link]]s, that states that the Khovanov homology for [[alternating link]]s is supported in two lines. During his works Professor Burgos has introduced some Mathematical concepts such as: Gravity Information in a tangle diagram, [[Alternating planar algebra]]s, and Rotation Number of Smoothings.<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Burgos-Soto|first1=Hernando|title=The Jones Polynomial and the planar algebra of alternating tangles|journal=Journal of Knot Theory and Its Ramifications|date=2010|volume=19|issue=11|page=1503|doi=10.1142/S0218216510008510|arxiv=0807.2600|s2cid=13993750 }}</ref>

==Selected Publication==
